text:
maria: Heads-up — we found a bad regression in the embeddings path (staging) that causes 10-15% inference latency spike for long tails. Need a hotfix and a short-window deploy.
kevin: ack. can you paste the failing test/log?
maria: repro log: ```ERROR kvcache miss ratio 0.72, avg token latency 78ms -> 130ms``` minimal patch in runtime to guard nil cache pointer.
kevin: patch looks small. will need release-note line + canary policy. change window is outside normal deploy hours (it's 22:15 PST).
suzanne: Paging duty: @duty-officer-elias — can you take approval? Impacting customer-critical flows (embeddings).
duty-officer-elias: Oncall here. Provide rollback plan and SLA tolerance. If rollback needs >5m route, we must coordinate traffic shift.
pm-jordan: From product: customers seeing degraded embeddings for search in a handful of large tenants — we want this expedited. Approve limited surge window if ops agrees.
kevin: Rollback plan: revert image tag -> previous stable (v2024-11-09-3). If rollback needed, deploybot run: `deploy revert v2024-11-09-3 --region global` and shift 100% back in 2m.
kevin: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 5m, watch latency, errors. If <1% error and median latency improves -> promote.
maria: I added a one-line release note: "Fix nil kv-cache guard causing tail latency spikes for embeddings (auto-rollout)." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/1745550001
duty-officer-elias: Approving expedited window for 30m. Conditions: must have oncall & kevin in channel, abort on >2% error or latency regress >20ms.
deploy-bot: @kevin requested deploy: `deploy start --image=registry/redd-inference:fix-kvcache-1745 --tag=hotfix-1745 --canary=5% --region=global`
kevin: running deploy now. tailing logs.
kevin: logs show initial canary pods up. health check: OK 2/2
kevin: canary metrics: median token latency down 34ms, error rate 0.1% — looks good.
maria: running small prompt evals vs canary -> quality unchanged.
suzanne: :thumbsup: from infra side. If green at 12m, promote to 50% then 100%.
pm-jordan: add release-note line to customer-facing changelog after full roll.
duty-officer-elias: monitoring window started. reminder: if rollback, make a postmortem note and tag customer-impact.
duty-officer-elias: +1 from me to expedite.
kevin: promoting to 50% now. deploy-bot: `deploy promote hotfix-1745 --percent=50`
deploy-bot: Promotion accepted, moving traffic to 50% over 60s.
kevin: 50% stable at +3m. metrics still good.
maria: rolling to 100% now.
kevin: deploy-bot: `deploy promote hotfix-1745 --percent=100`
deploy-bot: Promotion accepted, moving traffic to 100% over 2m.
kevin: 100% steady. final checks: latency improvement holds, no errors.
pm-jordan: Thanks — pushing to changelog and customer ops.
suzanne: Can we pin the image in Dedicated release config to avoid auto-roll next night?
kevin: Done: pinned to hotfix-1745 in release-config for next 48h. config diff: ```- model-serving-image: registry/redd-inference:stable
+ model-serving-image: registry/redd-inference:hotfix-1745 # pinned 48h
```
duty-officer-elias: Logging approval and final state. Closing window. Good run, file a quick postmortem doc later with root cause and mitigation for long-term fix.
maria: created brief postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/ops/postmortems/1745550001-hotfix-kvcache
kevin: tagging release note PR and adding slack summary to #general. :party:
